validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real and independently corroborated (high). The Aramco Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3, ~USD 18bn / ~4,153 km of new 56-inch pipe, +3.15 bscf/d by Q4 2028, construction commenced Q2 2024) is documented by multiple independent, non-GEM sources: MEED, BlackRidge Research, Oil & Gas News (OGN), Pipeline Technology Journal (L&T completion), AGBI and Zawya. Aramco awarded ~16 of 17 EPC packages mid-2024 to CPECC, Sepco, Gas Arabian, Mapa, L&T, Kalpataru, Nesma/Sicim, etc. CLASSIFICATION: correct — dry-gas TRANSMISSION trunk line on the East-West gas corridor (laying '56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four' / EWGP-3 and EWGP-4). Commodity=Gas and PipelineType=transmission both confirmed. DIAMETER: 56 in confirmed high (every source agrees the EW lines are 56-inch). OWNER: Aramco confirmed. STATUS: construction confirmed (commenced Q2 2024). START: 2028 completion confirmed (Q4 2028) — note StartYear1=2028 reads as commissioning/in-service, not construction start (2024); acceptable. SPEC CAVEAT (the one real reservation): GEM records this EWPS-3->EWPS-4 segment as 83 km, but three independent sources state the EWPS-3 to EWPS-4 run is 166 km. MEED: '...east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-3 to EWPS-4'. BlackRidge/OGN tabulate 'EWPS-3 to EWPS-4 = 166 km (Package 5)' and BlackRidge states explicitly that the 166 km 'represents the combined total for both pipeline lines, not per line.' GEM models the dual pipeline as two parallel rows — P6721 (line '3', 83 km) and P6722 (line '4', 83 km) — summing to 166 km. The 83 km value is therefore a DERIVED half of the published combined 166 km, not a figure any source states directly. This is a defensible modeling convention IF the two lines share one corridor and 166 was a both-lines sum; but if 166 is actually the route distance each line traverses, then both P6721 and P6722 are understated by half. No source resolves this directly. DUPLICATE: P6722 is the parallel twin (same EWPS-3->EWPS-4 segment, line '4', identical 83 km/56 in/construction) — this is a deliberate per-line split, NOT an erroneous duplicate; do not merge.
